66
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, August 27, 2012/Bhadra, 5, 1934 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Coal; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Corporate
Affairs; Earth Sciences; Information and Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines;
Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Parliamentary Affairs; Power;
Science and Technology; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
Scholarships to students belonging to
minority community
in Rajasthan
†*201. SHRI  ASHK ALI TAK: Will
the Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of students of minority
community provided with scholarships in
Rajasthan during 2011-12 along with the
amount thereof, category-wise; and
(b) the details of the students provided
with scholarships for higher education?
Computerisation of PDS
*202. SHRI B.S. GNANADESIKAN:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has decided to
spend ` 4,000 crore for end to end
computerisation of Public Distribution
System (PDS) to ensure that the highly
subsidised grains reach the intended
beneficiaries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government is also
considering a proposal to create a special
purpose vehicle for movement of
foodgrains in collaboration with the
Railways; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Power supply to areas near NTPC
projects
†*203. SHRI DHIRAJ PRASAD
SAHU: Will the Minister of POWER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any plan has been chalked
out to supply power to the areas located in
the vicinity of NTPC projects, run by the
Central Government, in the country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
it would be completed?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

67
National Media Awards Scheme
*204. SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN
IRANI: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether a National Media Awards
Scheme is under examination by
Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the category of persons who are
likely to be covered under the scheme; and
(d) by when the scheme is likely to be
finalised?
Socio-economic  development
works by CIL
*205. SHRI ANIL MADHA V DAVE:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) the different socio-economic
Development works taken up by the Coal
India Ltd. (CIL), around mining areas; and
(b) the details of such works taken up
during the last five years?
Power shortage in Maharashtra
*206. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is severe
shortage of power in Maharashtra;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
incomplete thermal power projects in
Vidarbha region have increased this power
shortage further;
(d) if so, the details of such projects;
and
(e) what action Government proposes
to take to ensure that such projects are
completed within a definite time-frame?
Buffer stock of pulses and
oilseeds
*207. SHRIMATI KUSUM RAI: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of buffer stock of pulses
and oilseeds with Government, at present;
(b) whether prices of pulses and edible
oils have shown trend of steep rise in
international markets due to severe drought
in various countries during July, 2012;
(c) if so, the estimated quantum of
pulses, oilseeds and edible oils India would
import during the current year;
(d) whether Government has assessed
the extent of rise in prices of pulses and
edible oils that would affect food inflation
in the country;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Declaration of Pranahita-Chevella
Project as national project
*208. SHRI DEVENDER GOUD T.:
Will the Minister of W ATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Andhra Pradesh
Government has sent any proposal to
declare Pranahita-Chevella Project as a
national project;
(b) if so, when the proposal was sent
along with other details;
(c) the progress made so far for
declaring the above project as a national
project; and

68
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(d) the reasons for delay in declaring it
as a national project?
Extension of subsidy to edible oils
*209. SHRIMATI RENUKA
CHOWDHURY: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
is contemplating extension of subsidy to
edible oils, in view of the steep rising trend
in the prices of edible oils;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the proposed subsidy is
limited to edible oils or there is any plan
of extending it to other commodities too;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
